exercises.title: Present continuous and present simple 1
exercises.rubric: Complete the sentences. Use the present continuous or present simple form of a verb from the list.

items.stem: At the moment he ______ as Hamlet at the Shakespeare Theatre.
I ______ people should be allowed to vote at the age of 16.
A: I hope you like the jumper. I didn’t know your size. B: It’s lovely and it ______ me perfectly.
items.model_answer: A: I hope you like the jumper. I didn’t know your size. B: It’s lovely and it fits me perfectly.

items.stem: The kitchen ______ about 3 metres wide and 12 metres long.
items.model_answer: The kitchen measures about 3 metres wide and 12 metres long.

items.stem: I ______ the window for some new curtains.
items.model_answer: I am measuring the window for some new curtains.

items.stem: We ______ books to be returned to the library on time.
items.model_answer: We expect books to be returned to the library on time.

items.stem: You must know Marie. She ______ red hair and green eyes.
items.model_answer: You must know Marie. She has red hair and green eyes.

items.stem: It's sunny and warm here, and we ______ a great holiday.
items.model_answer: It's sunny and warm here, and we are having a great holiday.

items.stem: The builders ______ a new shower today so we can’t use the bathroom.
items.model_answer: The builders are fitting a new shower today so we can’t use the bathroom.

items.stem: Judging by your reaction you ______ to have heard the news already.
items.model_answer: Judging by your reaction you appear to have heard the news already.

items.stem: A: What’s Carolina going to do at university? B: She ______ of doing medicine.
items.model_answer: A: What’s Carolina going to do at university? B: She is thinking of doing medicine.

items.stem: Has the post come yet? I ______ a very important letter.
items.model_answer: Has the post come yet? I am expecting a very important letter.

items.stem: Example 1 I was nervous in the exam and made ...... silly mistakes.
Example 2 My business takes me to ...... different places around Europe and Asia.
...... people were injured when the building collapsed, but amazingly no one was killed.
items.model_answer: A lot of people were injured when the building collapsed, but amazingly no one was killed.

items.stem: Natasha spends ...... her spare time painting and listening to music.
items.model_answer: Natasha spends much of / a lot of her spare time painting and listening to music.

items.stem: The scientists claim that they have ...... experimental data to support their findings.
items.model_answer: The scientists claim that they have a large amount of experimental data to support their findings.

items.stem: In the 17th century, Trinidad was geographically and politically isolated, and ...... its trade was done with England and with other Caribbean countries.
items.model_answer: In the 17th century, Trinidad was geographically and politically isolated, and much of its trade was done with England and with other Caribbean countries.

items.stem: There's ...... cheap accommodation in the town, so you don't need to book a room before you go.
items.model_answer: There's plenty of / lots of cheap accommodation in the town, so you don't need to book a room before you go.

items.stem: He lost ...... his money when the company went bust.
items.model_answer: He lost a lot of his money when the company went bust.

items.stem: The newly-formed Radical Party looks likely to win ...... votes in the forthcoming election.
items.model_answer: The newly-formed Radical Party looks likely to win a substantial number of votes in the forthcoming election.

items.stem: It was very hot, so we climbed the hill slowly with ...... stops along the way.
items.model_answer: It was very hot, so we climbed the hill slowly with a lot of / plenty of stops along the way.

items.stem: I drank ...... coffee during the evening and had difficulty sleeping.
items.model_answer: I drank far too much coffee during the evening and had difficulty sleeping.

items.stem: They had to spend ...... thousands of dollars repairing the church roof.
items.model_answer: They had to spend many thousands of dollars repairing the church roof.

exercises.title: Much (of), many (of), a lot of, lots (of), etc.
exercises.rubric: Complete the sentences. Choose one item from box (i) and one from box (ii).

items.stem: Example 1 The clear blue waters of the bay have appeared ______ ______ for holidays in Turkey.
Example 2 Not once did I ever see him become angry during ______ ______ we worked together.
James Svenson kindly agreed to meet me while he was in Berlin, despite ______ ______ during his short visit.
items.model_answer: James Svenson kindly agreed to meet me while he was in Berlin, despite his many other commitments during his short visit.

items.model_answer: The fish protects itself from its many enemies by raising long spines along its back when attacked.

items.model_answer: When Julianne Fay arrived at the hotel a number of porters emerged to take her many suitcases to her room.

items.stem: I used to spend ______ ______ just sitting in the garden reading a book.
items.model_answer: I used to spend many a sunny afternoon just sitting in the garden reading a book.

items.model_answer: Newville is an uninteresting place. Perhaps the only things that make it worth a stop are the fresh coffee and pastries sold in one of the many Danish bakeries in town.

items.stem: Greg Costikyan is a well-known games designer, and among ______ ______ are Toon, Paranoia, and MadMaze.
items.model_answer: Greg Costikyan is a well-known games designer, and among his many games are Toon, Paranoia, and MadMaze.

items.stem: North-east Scotland is noted for ______ ______, although these are rarely crowded even in summer.
items.model_answer: North-east Scotland is noted for its many miles of sandy beaches, although these are rarely crowded even in summer.

items.stem: George Clooney was just one of ______ ______ I met when I was living in Hollywood.
items.model_answer: George Clooney was just one of the many famous actors I met when I was living in Hollywood.

items.stem: Edwina Dean was perhaps the finest ballet dancer of her generation, and the King himself was one of ______ ______.
items.model_answer: Edwina Dean was perhaps the finest ballet dancer of her generation, and the King himself was one of her many admirers.

items.stem: Although he's now 70, he runs every day and is as fit as ______ ______ half his age.
items.model_answer: Although he's now 70, he runs every day and is as fit as many a man half his age.
